title: Ize Press Announces Print Licenses for Codename: Anastasia, Mignon BL Webtoons

title: When Avatar Aang: The Last Airbender Releases on Paramount+
content: Avatar Aang: The Last Airbender debuts this weekend, with the first project out of Avatar Studios getting a limited theatrical run from July 24-30 and releasing on Paramount+ on July 25.

title: Netflix’s First Half of 2026 Was Dominated by One Anime (And No One Even Came Close)
